chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: “Whoever causes harm by anything in the path of the Muslims is liable for it.”

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims; the public community using the road
key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ: by means of something; through any harmful object or cause
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: legally liable or responsible for compensation

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if they cause harm on a public road used by Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes liability for harm caused in public pathways used by Muslims. It conveys a legal and ethical principle that one who creates or causes a harmful condition in a shared public space is responsible for the resulting damage.
